page.overview:
Who is Raymond Dirk?

Sheriff Raymond Dirk is a character created by American comic book creator Michael Alan Nelson as one of the primary protagonists for The Gray Man story arc of his Mythos series Fall of Cthulhu. He made his first appearance in issue #11 in March 2008.

A well built man somewhere in his late thirties, Dirk is Sheriff of the Arkham Police Department, and as of the end of the Gray Man story arc, apparently one of the last. He is a tough but fair officer with an open mind, and is well aware of the flaws of those who work for him.

Several years prior to the events of The Gray Man, Dirk lost his beloved wife in a car accident; his actions in trying to help the people of Arkham resulted in him losing all memory of her very existence.

Dirk comes from a family with a tradition of holding the title of Sheriff in Arkham, being at least the third in his line to occupy that position; the officers under his command expect that if Dirk ever has a son, then he too will take up the role.
